notes: Mirrors the existing candidate mapping in cpp-tck.restore-save-after-federation-destruction. The Java case verifies one saved, explicit, unachieved synchronization point across federation-execution destruction and recreation; it does not claim complete save-image coverage or persistence across an RTI-process restart.

requirements.statement: The saved federation state remains restorable after destruction and recreation of its federation execution, witnessed by completion of one explicit two-member synchronization point that was unachieved at save time.
